data.title: 提弗洛斯 · 雪夜集市暖灯热饮摊
data.action: 雪夜街灯下递来一杯热姜茶
data.lighting: 摊位暖黄串灯与冷蓝雪夜环境光交织
data.description: 雪花落在派克外套厚实的毛领上很快融成水珠，提弗洛斯从热饮摊接过两只纸杯，顺手把更烫的那一杯往你手心里一塞。身后暖黄串灯映亮她微红的鼻尖与弯弯的眼角——「再站一会儿手都要冻僵了，边喝边把这条街逛完吧。」
data.promptProse: Under strings of warm lanterns at a snowy outpost night market, Typhoeus holds out a steaming paper cup of hot drink toward the viewer with a bright, inviting smile.
data.animaCaption: She stands beneath warm winter market lights in light falling snow, extending a steaming cup toward the viewer with a cheerful smile.
